title: Chain and AI routing
enabled: Find and monitor routes automatically on startup
policyHint: The current healthy AI exit stays selected. Confirmed faults trigger recovery, keeping the rear node or its country when possible. AI routes exclude Hong Kong. Use the existing system proxy switch to request takeover after verification. Adaptive routing uses Rule mode. Disable it before switching to Global or Direct.
priorityHint: Lists run from highest to lowest priority. Empty lists use the automatic policy. Unavailable preferred nodes fall back to other verified routes.
chainHint: Subscriptions assigned to both roles use two hops. Single-hop fallback requires explicit permission.
aiExcludedHint: Hong Kong is always excluded. Select additional countries here. Disabled services use ordinary rules.
mechanismHint: Healthy AI exits stay pinned. General routes switch after the hold interval and improvement thresholds. Recovery requires fresh verification. Candidate limits apply per round; subsequent rounds rotate candidates.
probePortHint: Uses 16 consecutive local ports. Conflicts with existing proxy ports are checked on save.
networkPending: A network change is settling before current routes are revalidated.
noEligible: No eligible routes. Check subscription roles and excluded countries.
recoveringService: Keeping the current route while verifying a replacement

reason.verify_candidates: Revalidating current routes and representative candidates
reason.retry_backoff: Keeping current selections while retrying in batches
reason.healthy_pinned: Monitoring selected routes; healthy AI exits stay pinned
reason.network_unavailable: Keeping selections until the physical network returns
reason.wait_hold: The best candidate from this round will be revalidated once after the hold interval
reason.verifying_cached: Last known route restored; verifying it now
reason.verifying_background: General line online; AI groups still verifying in the background

mechanisms.recovery_budget: Recovery budget per service and round

autoHint: Find a usable route quickly on startup, then switch automatically after confirmed failures.
roleHint: Right-click a subscription to set its front or rear role. Both roles use two hops; no roles or just one role uses a single hop.
